checked: Missing, ignored, unrelated and partial libtest verdicts cannot qualify a required group.
A later Cargo failure cannot be overwritten by a successful named verdict.
Wry tests run in separate processes; ordinary test selection does not create native windows.
Native assertion panics propagate after Tauri event-loop cleanup.
Both libtest and application binaries link successfully with the opt-in Windows manifest.
CI compiles dependencies before bounded test execution to avoid treating cold build time as a window timeout.
Native tests retain their command/window scope; installer, Godot and device acceptance remain distinct.
residualLimits: Local native evidence qualifies Windows only.
Native fixture tests do not execute the production startup plugins or signed installers.
